idea-plugin.name: QuickQuestion for Claude
idea-plugin.description:
Select code in the editor and ask Claude a quick question about it, without leaving your file.

  • Ask Claude from the floating code toolbar, the editor context menu, or Ctrl+Alt+K.
  • A movable, resizable popup holds a throwaway multi-turn chat that stays open while you read the code.
  • Move the live chat to a sidebar tab with one click.
  • Select different code while a chat is open and it is included with your next message.
  • Streamed Markdown replies with syntax-highlighted code; Foo.kt:42 style references open the file at that line.

Requirements: the Claude Code CLI must be installed and signed in. The plugin starts it in headless mode, one process per chat.

Data: the selected code and your questions are sent to Anthropic through the Claude Code CLI. Claude can also read other files in the project (read-only: Read, Grep, Glob) to answer, so keep secrets out of files you do not want it to see. The plugin itself collects no telemetry.

QuickQuestion for Claude is an independent, unofficial plugin. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anthropic. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic.

  • 0.1.0: Initial version. Ask Claude about selected code in a popup, move the chat to a sidebar tab.
